title: Best BBQ Catering Companies in Dubai: What to Compare
body_html:
Choosing BBQ catering in Dubai starts with the venue and the style of gathering. A live grill, prepared BBQ menu and fully staffed outdoor meal each require a different setup. Compare the complete service around the food you want to share.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Confirm the grill arrangements

Ask who supplies the grill, fuel, cooking equipment and serving stations. The venue must permit the proposed cooking method, with suitable space and ventilation. For yachts or apartment terraces, obtain the operator’s or building’s confirmation before assuming live grilling is possible.

Build a balanced BBQ menu

Compare the proteins, vegetarian dishes, salads, breads and sauces as a complete meal. Check whether quantities are per guest or per platter and how food will be replenished. Include children and dietary requirements in the initial count.

Agree the service duration

Live cooking requires a plan for setup, service and safe clear-down. Ask how long the chef remains, whether waiters manage the table and what happens if the event runs late. myCHEF BBQ and live-station formats start from AED 150 per person, subject to the agreed scope and VAT.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Explore the myCHEF service

If BBQ catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

Explore BBQ catering · Request a proposal
